attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole entry is a couplet and one sentence of four words. The page carries no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The only rank it gives him is «Όσιος», which is what `types` holds; it gives no century, no place and no monastery, so there is no `dates` object. No hymn is printed.
